rationale: Rick's decade-long expertise building Pangian—a global remote talent platform leveraging AI/ML to match professionals across 150+ countries—directly complements Anant's focus on AI workflows and agent-based systems for automation. As a Techstars mentor actively advising early-stage founders, Rick can offer strategic guidance on scaling deep-tech applications, while Anant's work on AI pipelines aligns with Rick's conviction that ML will be central to talent-opportunity matching at scale.
intro_message: Rick Uzcategui, meet Anant Dwivedi — Anant is building AI workflows and automation systems, and Rick's experience scaling Pangian with ML-driven talent matching and early-stage mentorship could offer valuable perspective for deep-tech product development.
